description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Domino Data Lab builds AI solutions for highly regulated organizations, offering a platform for model and application development, hosting, and governance. The New Grad Software Engineer will contribute across the full stack, including backend services, APIs, frontend features, and cloud provider integrations, while working on scalable enterprise systems and high-visibility projects.
Software engineer building data science platforms across backend services, APIs, frontend features, and cloud integrations

Responsibilities:
• As a new grad Software Engineer at Domino, you’ll be working alongside talented engineers from all backgrounds to build the platform that powers how data science is done at some of the world’s largest companies
• Our new grad engineers are versatile and eager to learn, contributing across the full stack - from backend services and APIs, to frontend features, to integrations with cloud providers like AWS, Azure, and GCP
• At Domino, we trust our junior engineers to contribute to critical and high-visibility projects from the start
• You’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on your team and the company as a whole beginning on day one

Requirements:
• Strong computer science fundamentals and experience with modern software engineering practices (algorithms, data structures, operating systems, networking, etc.)
• Proficiency with one or more of our core technologies: Python, Go, TypeScript, React, GraphQL, Kubernetes, Docker, Postgres, Redis, Kafka
• Excitement about learning new technologies and contributing to scalable enterprise systems
• Graduating in Spring 2027, currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field
